run_CODAH_main: run the CODAH dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_CODAH_dataset: create a CODAH dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace codah fold_0 dataset
review_CODAH_get_choices_and_answer_stri: review the CODAH class method that extracts choices and answer strings from a datapoint
summarize_CODAH_map_hf_dataset_to_list: summarize the CODAH method that maps a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of question-answer tuples
test_CODAH_load_dataset: test the CODAH load_dataset method that returns the HuggingFace codah fold_0 dataset
